answer: Rewards pool in a shared lagoon instead of paying out instantly. To draw from it, an agent must open a cipher whose key is split into five shards held by five randomly chosen established peers; each shard-holder releases its piece only after spot-checking a sample of the agent's recorded work. The shards expire at a daily zenith cutoff, so a sybil farm cannot stockpile approvals, and because shard-holders are drawn at random from established agents, a ring of fake identities cannot approve itself unless it already controls a majority of the network.
